title.zh: 将巴丹省奥拉尼的菲律宾工匠国立学校（BNSFC）改设为巴丹国立理工学院并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Bataan National School for Filipino Craftsman (BNSFC) in Orani, Bataan, Into the Bataan National Polytechnic School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Bataan National School for Filipino Craftsman (BNSFC) in Orani, Bataan, Into the Bataan National Polytechnic School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_7914_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Bataan National School for Filipino Craftsman in Orani Bataan, is hereby converted into the Bataan National Polytechnic School, under the supervision of the on Higher Education (CHED), or of the appropriate body that now or hereafter may be created by law.
The School shall offer vocational and technical courses as may be authorized by the CHED, or by the body that now or hereafter may be created by law.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Bataan National School for Filipino Craftsman. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
